events.title: Full Release on November 11 | Historical Campaigns Included, No Separate DLC
events.summary: Hello everyone, I’m the solo developer of the game. The final release date for KIT Three Kingdoms: Heroes at War is now confirmed: November 11, 2026 The Steam store date is currently being updated, so the new date may take a little time to appear on the page. The content release plan has also changed. The separately planned Historical Campaign DLC has been cancelled. events.title: Steam Playtest Ends September 30 — Free Demo Launches October 1
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who participated in the Steam Playtest and helped us test the game! The Steam Playtest will close on September 30, 2026. The free KIT Three Kingdoms: Heroes at War Demo will launch on October 1, 2026. The Demo includes battles and historical campaign content, so you can continue experiencing the game ahead of the full release. Thank you again for your support. We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield!

events.title: Demo Coming Soon | Steam Next Fest | Full Release Planned for Late October
events.summary: Hello everyone! We’re happy to confirm that KIT Three Kingdoms: Heroes at War will be taking part in the October 2026 Steam Next Fest. Steam Next Fest The event runs from Oct 19, 2026 at 10:00 AM PDT to Oct 26, 2026 at 10:00 AM PDT. Demo planned before the event We currently plan to make the demo available before the festival begins. The exact timing will be announced once everything is ready.
